verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Cerebras engineering docs referencing TTFT-reduction mechanisms (tcp_warming) and numerous community reports citing extremely fast token throughput (e.g. '10x faster than fastest alternative', '1k tokens/s', '100 tok/s' comparisons), but there is no first-party published benchmark suite, standardized tokens-per-second table, or load-testing guide in the pack—only anecdotal HN comments and a generic warming API. Missing for 10: an official benchmark page with methodology, a documented tokens/s/latency leaderboard, and a load-testing guide.
